summary: Fixed a data race in the evidence/case export job trackers (evidenceExportService.Create in evidence_export.go and .CreateCase in case_export.go): the initial job snapshot returned to the caller (`cp := *job`) was copied after s.mu was unlocked and after the background build goroutine had already been queued, so a fast-running builder could call setStatus and mutate *job concurrently with the snapshot copy - caught intermittently by the nightly `go test -race` run (TestACaseBundleShipsWhatItHasAndSaysWhatIsMissing, Go check #216/#223/#229/#230). Both call sites now take the `cp := *job` snapshot while still holding s.mu, before s.mu.Unlock() and before the builder goroutine is spawned, so the copy can no longer race with the goroutine's first status write.
compatibility: Internal concurrency fix only; no change to the export job API, response shape, or job lifecycle behavior seen by callers. Existing installs need no migration or action - this only removes a race window that `go test -race` could intermittently flag in CI, it does not change any user-visible or persisted data.
